sealed_historical_data_policy: Files outside data/current are historical audit material only and must not count as current progress or active database input.

task_types.ordinary_business: collection/alignment/source/transcript/data tasks that do not require real decoded-media inspection unless explicitly stated
task_types.real_playback: ordinary workers may execute P9-PLAYBACK-* through the repository Playback Evidence Service; local ffmpeg/content inspection is only an optional fallback
task_types.gate_or_report: aggregate current P9/P10/gate/report work; once prerequisites are satisfied it does not itself require replaying media
task_types.admin_control: bug repair/control-plane/schema/CI/workflow maintenance; admin role only
task_types.legacy_record: immutable historical completion identity retained for audit only; never claim and never use as current acceptance evidence

notes: Existing valid claims remain owned by their current agents and are not migrated mid-task.
New claims must continue to the next eligible task unless a documented stop condition applies.
Only verified witnessGIT management-account Agents may fix bugs or modify the protected control plane; unknown identity defaults to worker.
Worker Agents execute claimed business/playback tasks and submit bugs to coordination/bug_reports/; they do not repair project machinery.
Ordinary worker Agents may perform Playback Audit through repository-generated evidence without local ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp, Whisper or a graphical player.
Playback requests must use a media URL already preserved in repository provenance for the requested canonical live; the repository service is not an arbitrary downloader.
GitHub Actions performs real-media decoding, offline Whisper ASR and frame OCR; optional SmolVLM2 is supplemental and not required for every request.
Repository evidence is durable but does not count toward Pilot-60 until a worker reads it and submits an exact bundle-bound acceptance.
The validator independently cross-checks v2 repository evidence, worker acceptance, canonical case/live/segment identity, timing and media provenance.
Local/manual qualifying_playback_timing_check_v1 remains supported as a fallback; repository evidence produces qualifying_playback_timing_check_v2.
A single GitHub create_file 422 or 409 must be classified against fresh repository state before it can become a write error.
If the exact claim exists after a failed create, classify CLAIM_RACE_LOST, refresh state, and try another eligible task immediately.
If a 409 leaves the exact claim absent, classify a moving-branch retry, refresh main, short-backoff, and retry against fresh state.
Only classify GITHUB_WRITE_ERROR when the exact claim remains absent after fresh bounded retries and no race/staleness/moving-main explanation applies.
External prompts should not duplicate project requirements; Agents must load them from the repository.
An occupied task or CLAIM_RACE_LOST is internal queue control flow and must not be emitted as a final chat response; the same session must refresh and attempt another eligible candidate.

The historical completed records P9-AUDIT-60 and P10-PILOT-DECISION predate the current playback-gated acceptance chain. Keep them for audit history, but never treat them as current completion or authorization.
The current acceptance tasks are P9-AUDIT-60-R2 and P10-PILOT-DECISION-R2.
An S-AUDIT completion or coordination/ready/audit marker does not by itself contribute a Pilot-60 playback check.
Successful media decode without content evidence and explicit review contributes zero qualifying playback checks.
Playback decode windows must include time before and after the expected timestamp so both negative and positive signed timing errors can be measured.
P9-AUDIT-60-R2 remains blocked until scripts/audit_gate.py passes and scripts/playback_queue.py --seal-gate creates P9-PLAYBACK-GATE.
If Pilot-60 already passes, remaining extra playback cases do not create HOST_STOP for the acceptance path; seal P9-PLAYBACK-GATE and continue with current P9/P10.
Current P9/P10 are gate/report tasks and do not require media replay once prerequisites have been satisfied.
An admin Agent must not report HOST_STOP merely because local playback is unavailable when open admin bug reports or other compatible work remain.
P10-PILOT-DECISION-R2 remains blocked until P9-AUDIT-60-R2 completes.
A completed current P10 record does not authorize FULL_ARCHIVE unless it contains full_archive_decision=YES.
SAFETY_OR_ACCESS_BLOCK is reserved for access that would require bypassing login, CAPTCHA, paywall, DRM, or other controls.
